summary: Iteration 20: Booking system fully tested. All backend APIs (POST /api/booking/create, GET /api/booking/list) working correctly. Frontend booking form on /close page submits to backend API. Admin dashboard Bookings tab displays all bookings. 10/10 backend tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In HighTicketClose.jsx, handleBooking() references 'user' variable before its declaration (line 88 vs line 105). Works due to JS hoisting but could be cleaner if user was defined before the function.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed bookings during testing (TEST_Booking_*, TEST_Notes_*, TEST_ResponseFields, TEST_Persist_*, TEST_MongoDB_*, TEST_Count_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 verified booking system: (1) POST /api/booking/create creates booking with date, time, name, email, plan, returns {success, message, booking_date, booking_time}. (2) GET /api/booking/list returns {bookings: [], total: int}. (3) Bookings stored in MongoDB 'bookings' collection with status='pending'. (4) Frontend /close page booking form visible when Fast Track plan selected, submits to backend API. (5) Admin dashboard has Bookings tab showing all bookings in table format. (6) Email notifications sent via Resend to expert (start@aiporate.com) and user confirmation.
